title: Cross-project capability, lineage, and native-acceptance refresh
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan update
scope: Compare open-source DWG/DXF routes by format, version, direction, and implementation lineage
Refresh ACadSharp stable-release versus development-issue evidence
Bound IxMilia.Dxf and ezdxf as direct-DXF comparators
Separate Autodesk 3DSOLID carrier framing from ACIS semantic evidence
Reconfirm FreeCAD DWG-converter and DXF-import consumer boundaries
Refine implementation-ready local and optional external gates without increasing test cadence

sources.project: ACadSharp README, releases, and issue board
sources.observation: The README declares direction/version matrix rows and excludes AC1021 DWG writing. The latest signed release shown is v3.7.1, while several open issue bodies refer to 3.8.0 NuGet or 3.8.10/master. Peer reports span culture-sensitive codepage lookup, legacy VERTEX subtype handling, repeated-record stack exhaustion, and output acceptance. These are version- and report-specific claims, not reproduced results for libdxfrw or every peer release.

LibreDWG is an independent DWG codec lineage, but its own class documentation distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled classes, and describes skip/proxy/placeholder degradation. Version-wide or converter claims do not establish a particular entity's lossless survival.

The project is a DXF/DXB reader/writer, not a DWG codec. Its README describes R10-R2014 coverage with explicit entity omissions and warns of AutoCAD acceptance limitations for some typed modeler entities. It was not executed.

sources.project: ezdxf feature index, ACIS API, and drawing limitations
sources.observation: The DXF library documents ASCII/Binary format coverage and third-party content retention. ACIS parsing/authoring is limited to documented subsets, unsupported entities can lose data, curved-surface evaluation requires a kernel, and its drawing add-on has no 3D renderer or ACIS rendering.

The entity table describes group 70 modeler version, proprietary groups 1/3, the AcDb3dSolid subclass, and optional group 350 history owner. It is a carrier schema and does not define ACIS semantics or modern AcDs/ACDSDATA layout.

sources.project: FreeCAD Draft DXF/DWG documentation and importDWG.py
sources.observation: FreeCAD's DWG import path converts DWG to DXF and then calls the selected DXF importer. The documented stock importer backends have explicit-entity subsets and do not read embedded ACIS/SAT solids; this is not a direct DWG or ACIS semantic route.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06/PAR-07/S2/S8: record exact codec artifact, version, direction, source identity, owner/block membership, and loss stage
PAR-07/S8: separate raw modeler carrier, ACIS graph/topology, B-rep/kernel semantics, and consumer acceptance
PAR-14/PAR-52/7AE: map peer safety/locale reports to existing generated fast controls; do not duplicate tests based only on peer reports
FreeCAD/native gate: bind converter, emitted DXF, importer backend/options, per-entity disposition, and platform separately
assessment.planImpact: Peer capability matrices are not promoted into semantic support claims. Use existing fast local controls before adding vectors; admit one exact pinned optional peer only for an unanswered format/version/direction question. FreeCAD's stock DWG-to-DXF route remains separate from embedded ACIS semantics. No test cadence increase or new dependency is introduced.

method.limitations: Project READMEs, version matrices, issue reports, and documentation were reviewed but peer behavior was not reproduced. Open issue reports are not treated as normative rules or local defects; supported peer versions and test data were not executed. No new geometry semantics, independent kernel result, native CAD result, or platform qualification was obtained.
